description: Encrypt any file with a password into the website's .s3enc format: chunked AES-256-GCM, key from PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 rounds, random salt), original name/type/size stored encrypted inside, tamper/truncation/reorder-proof. Files made here open at https://s3eidat.github.io/file-encrypt/ and vice versa (crypto_file_decrypt). Whole file is processed in memory (size limit = server --max-mb). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/file-encrypt/

file.description: The file to encrypt: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

mimeType.description: MIME type to store. Default: guessed from the extension like a browser would ("" if unknown).

name.description: File name to store inside (restored on decrypt). Default: the input file name.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

password.description: The password. Normalised to Unicode NFC first, like the website.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

name: crypto_file_encrypt
title: Encrypt a file (.s3enc)
